## Stack

Back end: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, REST APIs, microservices,
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, JUnit. Front end: React Native, Expo, React,
TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Jest. Infra: Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD, EAS,
Google Cloud Platform, Maven.

## Experience — SHX (Jan 2021 – present)

- Built REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot serving 1000+ daily users;
  performance work cut response times by up to 70%.
- Delivered enterprise integrations across SAP, e-commerce, and
  payment/POS systems, including a third-party SDK for smart-POS card
  transactions.
- Shipped React Native and Expo apps used by 1000+ people, including a
  real-time sales-tracking app built in two weeks on a self-built Spring
  Boot API.
- Ran CI/CD with Jenkins, GitHub, and EAS; containerized services with
  Docker; operated the architecture on Google Cloud Platform.
